objects.name: poster
objects.description: Someone who posts what he has on offer to the people of an agency, and who is approved before he is shown.

objects.name: offer
objects.description: What a poster has on offer, in his own words, at a price.

objects.name: request
objects.description: What a picker wants, in her words.

objects.name: ask
objects.description: One poster asked one question about one request or offer.

objects.name: notice
objects.description: What a picker wants shown to every poster until she takes it down.

objects.name: yes
objects.description: A poster's yes to an ask, kept as a record until delivered or called off.

objects.name: order
objects.description: A picker's order with a poster, keeping the terms it started with.

objects.name: group_order
objects.description: An order several pickers join, with a minimum and terms that can be revised.

objects.name: line
objects.description: One picker's amount in a group order and her answer to the current terms.

objects.name: stock
objects.description: A poster's own private count for a product.

objects.name: trail
objects.description: Who did what to an order and when.
